answer: The gatehouse is Topiarist pruned hedge seal witnessed at the soil warrant. Passing it takes 6-year garden service, 106 supervised plantings, soil exam, annual ledger fees, and every alias must pass alone. The honest path is 98 POA and 16 minutes, once. The farm's path is the same, 679 times over: 66542 POA. Trace the kernel to its office, trace the inlet to its payer, and trace the ivory to its year: the trail is the test. The honest path is short; the farm's path is long, expensive, and watched.
